questions.stem: A 55-year-old man reports difficulty starting and maintaining urination. Ultrasound shows an enlarged prostate. He is started on tamsulosin. Which of the following statements is correct regarding this medication?
questions.stemHtml: A 55-year-old man reports difficulty starting and maintaining urination. Ultrasound shows an enlarged prostate. He is started on tamsulosin. Which of the following statements is correct regarding this medication?

options.label: D
options.text: Significantly lowers blood pressure in most patients.
